result: For the full owner target, if s=s_3(A)>=1 and C_* is the sharp universal density constant, then C_*=sup s||p_Q||_infinity. For every R>0, C_*=sup_{|t|>=R}s p_Q(t). For every R>1, C_*=sup_{|y|>=R}(s/2)P(|Q-y|<=1)=sup_{|y|>=R}s E(1-|Q-y|)_+. Thus one may require the unit observation window to stay an arbitrarily prescribed distance from the sole critical output zero, with zero loss in the sharp constant.
correction_preserved: QFORM-TWOSHEET-XRAY-ONLY-FALSE already fails at noncritical level -1, so the critical-gap reduction does not justify projection-only control.
first_unpaid_implication: For a convenient fixed R such as 2, prove sup_target,|y|>=2 [s_3(A)/2] P(|X^TAX-y|<=1)<infinity using product-preserving structure.
